title: Sum Sum Max
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq T \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; The sum of N in a single file is at most 2 \times 10^5.; 1 \leq M \leq 10^9; |x_i| \leq 4 \, (1 \leq i \leq N); y_i \gt 0 \, (1 \leq i \leq N); \sum_{k = 1}^N y_k = M; All values in input are integers.
